Landed — every `<a>` now gets the house link style, not just ones in prose, and `Server/smoke.mjs` fails the merge on text flush against an unpadded edge or anything above a page's title. Commit `a3248c70` on `michael/dev`.

Landed: `ext/Mention/maps/refs.js`'s icon rebuilds itself. [`Server/plugins/MentionSync.js`](/framework/servex/fs/?file=Server) sits on the dev server's shared watcher and rewrites a changed icon on its own — proved live by flipping `core/Sidebar/page.js`'s icon and watching `refs.js` update within ~2s, no `sync.mjs` run (`task.jsonl`).
One line down from Draggable, not inside it — `core/Item/Store.js`'s `hops()` dropped a list's own name whenever a change was the list's own add/remove/move/order.
The Now card's sections are back, above Topics, and its rail preview never reads empty again. Details, the replay test and the review: [task log](task.jsonl).
`Server/page-ai-cost.mjs` landed — splits each task's cost evenly across the pages it touched, writes it onto each page's own log (law 7: never recomputed).
PageLog is gone — Page extends Item directly (e7f5a714)
Every chrome.exe Playwright starts is recognisable and reaped; Servex can check a page's console for you.

A subagent's report is no longer logged as your prompt. The hook skipped nothing before, so four hand-backs in this tab were saved as your Prompts and refined at about $0.35 each, and your real prompt waited behind them.

The echo refiner was silently dead since this morning — found and fixed. `read_item()` in Echo.js matched the retired line shape; today's wire change broke it with zero error. Fixed, verified live. Added real per-prompt + session cost. A deeper wiring break remains, routed to @mastermind-servex.
Landed on `michael/dev` (`c25c5a39`). Hold a bound key/mouse combo anywhere on the site, a floating mic (bottom-right) appears and scales with your voice; click it to open the dev shell's chat tab.
